participation.context: Read the two bills and did not look for a name under either title.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the Rose's bill first, and then your own. You went in to the morning's work. You did not go to their door.

title: Read the comedy bill and The Grecian Comedy

participation.context: Said the speeches were the company's, and went on as Navarre.

participation.context: Gave the count, every third man, and kept Thursday next as the answer she had already given.
participation.name: Goodwife Margery Pell

participation.context: Named the inns, and named Thursday the sixteenth for the next king.

participation.context: Took the shout of Remuneration, and stayed Sweet Master Shakespeare.

participation.context: Refused the sale, and looked at the quoting man as at a burglar.

story.body: You refused the door a printed king. You left the moot with the man who brought it. You went up to the comedy you were cast in.
